# DevSec Status

> Automated popularity, momentum, and statistics tracker for Programming Languages, Web Frameworks, Databases, and Cybersecurity Tools.
> Curates 127 open-source technologies across 8 granular categories, actively tracking live GitHub metrics (stars, repository volume, 30-day velocity) for 100% of tracked projects.

## Pages
- [Software Ecosystem](https://devsec-status.vercel.app/): Tracks automated GitHub stars, repositories, and momentum for programming languages, frameworks, databases, and Linux distributions (96 metric-tracked projects).
- [Cybersecurity & SecOps](https://devsec-status.vercel.app/security): Tracks open-source security tools, vulnerability scanners, and security distribution lab platforms (29 metric-tracked projects).
